wings:
ULT=$(/usr/local/bin/rclone --config /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf lsf 'drive:BackUp VPS' --include 'wings_*.tgz.enc' | sort | tail -1)
echo "RESPALDO_DRIVE $ULT"
/usr/local/bin/rclone --config /root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf copy "drive:BackUp VPS/$ULT" /root/control-t82/ || exit 10
BACKUP="/root/control-t82/$ULT"
wingstest:
mkdir -p /root/control-t82/arma
mysqldump --single-transaction --routines --triggers wingstest > /root/control-t82/arma/wings.sql || exit 10
cp /home/wingstest/app/.env /root/control-t82/arma/env.txt || exit 11
tar -czf /root/control-t82/arma/storage.tgz -C /home/wingstest/app storage/app || exit 12
tar -czf /root/control-t82/paquete.tgz -C /root/control-t82/arma wings.sql env.txt storage.tgz || exit 13
openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -salt -in /root/control-t82/paquete.tgz -out /root/control-t82/wingstest_control.tgz.enc -pass file:/root/wings-backup/clave || exit 14
BACKUP=/root/control-t82/wingstest_control.tgz.enc
echo PAQUETE_PRUEBA_PROPIO_CREADO
